local_checks.invariant: No model-chosen web search or web API call in the composed thak profile reaches the official DeepSeek API or reads DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
local_checks.result: The thak profile composes @deepseek-ai/dsh-base and @deepseek-ai/dsh-headless (home/dot_dsh/profiles/thak/package.json:7-10). In the pinned upstream tree (~/.dsh/dsh/current (dsh-v0.2.1-rc.5, read as upstream context)), the base bundle mounts the web seam with searchProvider deepseek-official (packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml:467-471) and the two rows web-search-deepseek and web-deepseek-api, each with apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY (:473-481); the headless bundle mounts no web row. U227f disables both rows under exactly those ids (home/dot_dsh/profiles/thak/cordis.patch.yml:9-12), through the same by-id mechanism as llm-deepseek and llm-deepseek-account (:5-8). With them disabled, no mounted row registers a search provider: the only other registrants upstream (web-search-perplexity, web-search-exa) are mounted by no bundle the profile composes, and the kit inserts only omp-gateway and hooks-claude-code (:19-35). The seam resolves a configured provider at execution time and throws WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING when that id is not registered (packages/web/web/src/index.ts:68-74, :143, :181), with no priority chain; DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER feeds the same field (:94). So a model-chosen web_search fails closed, and no row left in the composed tree reads DEEPSEEK_API_KEY; the base bundle's only apiKeyEnv rows are the two disabled ones. The generator emits the same two rows (scripts/generate-agent-configs.py:2286-2289), and the new test pins them (tests/unit/test_dsh_profile.py:133-137) beside the existing check that the patch text names no apiKeyEnv (:124). This refutes the carried lead dsh-profile:web-search-routes-to-the-official-api on current source.
